verdict.rationale: Data residency is a fair question for a cloud SaaS work-tracking product like Jira, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions choosing a storage region or data residency. The features, integrations, REST API, sandbox, SSO and MCP items concern other capabilities and do not transfer to this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
